about_section_00_p_01: At Perth Soup Company, we are dedicated to making delicious, healthy and balanced, locally-grown meals easy for you to enjoy. Our selection of soups and chillis are made in small batches with the utmost care.
about_section_00_p_02: We use stainless steel and ceramic cookware and the best ingredients available. We source our ingredients close to home and we strive to use seasonal Ontario vegetables for maximum freshness. We believe supporting Ontario agriculture promotes food resiliency and benefits everyone.
about_section_00_p_03: Our extensive experience in food service has given us a deep understanding of what consumers are looking for in today's convenience foods: quality local products made without added preservatives or filler.
hours_location_00: Saturdays - May through October, Harvest & Holiday Markets
offerings_00: We offer frozen soups, pies, quiche, preserves, pickles, and more
